summary: Adds a way for Provider Backbone Bridging EVPN routers to tell each other to forget learned customer MAC addresses at the level of a single service instance (I-SID). It covers cases where the attachment circuit has no Ethernet Segment defined, so networks recover faster after a failure on a single-active multihomed link.

eli5.summary: When a road closes, a delivery company must tell drivers to forget old directions. This lets network devices quickly erase outdated address notes for one customer service, so traffic finds the new route sooner.
